Issue:
[ISSUE]
**Title:** HTTP Parser Fails to Reject Data After `Connection: close` Header

**Description:**
When an HTTP request includes the `Connection: close` header followed by additional data, the HTTP parser does not reject the extra data as expected. Instead of raising a `BadHttpMessage` error indicating that data was received after the connection was closed, it raises a `BadStatusLine` error due to the unexpected additional data.

**Example:**
[code block delimiter removed]python
def test_http_request_message_after_close(parser: HttpRequestParser) -> None:
    text = b"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\nInvalid\r\n\r\n"
    parser.feed_data(text)
[code block delimiter removed]

**Expected Behavior:**
The parser should raise a `BadHttpMessage` error with the message "Data after `Connection: close`" when it encounters any data following the `Connection: close` header.

**Actual Behavior:**
Instead of the expected error, the parser raises a `BadStatusLine` error with the message "Bad status line 'Invalid'", indicating that it did not properly handle the data after the connection was supposed to be closed.

[/ISSUE]
